mapper.select: SELECT rcp_seq,rcp_nm,rcp_way2,rcp_pat2,info_wgt,info_eng,info_car,info_pro,info_fat, info_na,hash_tag,att_file_no_main,att_file_no_main,att_file_no_mk,rcp_parts_dtls,rcp_na_tip, user_id,nickname,hit FROM recipe r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE rcp_seq=#{rcp_seq}
SELECT recipe_id,name,amount,unit,amount_text,original,NVL(category_name,'기타') as category_name FROM Ingredient_unit LEFT JOIN ingredient ON name = Ingredient_name WHERE recipe_id=#{rcp_seq}
SELECT rcp_seq,step_no,manual_desc,manual_img FROM recipe_manual WHERE rcp_seq=#{rcp_seq} ORDER BY step_no ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipe_like WHERE recipe_id=#{recipe_id} AND user_id=#{user_id}
DELETE FROM recipe_bookmark WHERE recipe_id=#{recipe_id} AND user_id=#{user_id}
mapper.select: SELECT rcp_seq,rcp_nm,att_file_no_main,hit,nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like r WHERE r.recipe_id = rcp_seq ) AS count FROM recipe r join recipe_like l on r.rcp_seq = l.recipe_id join users u on r.user_id = u.id WHERE l.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY l.create_at DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like WHERE user_id = #{user_id}

SELECT rcp_seq,rcp_nm,att_file_no_main,hit,nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_bookmark r WHERE r.recipe_id = rcp_seq ) AS count FROM recipe r join recipe_bookmark l on r.rcp_seq = l.recipe_id join users u on r.user_id = u.id WHERE l.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY l.create_at DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{user_id}

SELECT recipe_id FROM ingredient_unit WHERE recipe_id != #{recipe_id} AND name IN ( SELECT name FROM ingredient_unit WHERE recipe_id = #{recipe_id} ) GROUP BY recipe_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT name) DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT id,users_id,subject,content,image_url,rcp_seq,created_at FROM review_board WHERE rcp_seq=#{rcp_seq} ORDER BY created_at DESC
